hypothesis: An isolated Binance perpetual-versus-spot basis shock that Polymarket follows without spot or Deribit confirmation is a transient derivative-specific wedge; buy the opposite Polymarket side only when its direct ask remains at least three cents below the pre-impact complementary fair value after fee.

signal.decision_time: the first local receipt when the immutable shock, quiet-source confirmations and a qualifying already-received direct Polymarket book are all known; do not wait for another book frame
signal.fair: one minus the direct direction-side midpoint observed before the immutable futures crossing

causality.total_order: stable merged input order within equal receipt timestamps
causality.disconnect: clear all live source and direct-book state; require fresh frames and snapshots
causality.regressed_receipt_time: clear all live state and reject the regressed frame

execution.limit: highest direct ask required to fill five shares at the frozen signal, unchanged afterward
execution.partial_fills: record every positive FAK fill and its PnL; only full five-share fills enter the primary stopping sample
execution.fee_rounding: total USDC fee rounded to five decimals using half-up
execution.fill_price: five-share VWAP across direct asks no worse than the frozen limit

controls.no_wedge: same Polymarket follow and reverse-side edge rules with 0 < absolute basis change <= 0.5 bp
controls.direction_reversal: at each base decision buy five directly displayed shares of the basis-follow side at its own frozen five-share limit; this diagnostic intentionally does not reapply the reverse model-edge gate
controls.time_shift: at base decision plus exactly 5000 ms, preserve the original reverse side, fair and limit; send only if at least five direct shares remain at or below that limit, then evaluate 400/500 ms from the delayed decision
controls.confirmation: same >=1.5 bp basis shock, Polymarket follow and reverse-side edge rules when a strictly post-shock spot move exceeds 0.35 bp or Deribit move exceeds 0.5 bp in the basis direction
controls.shared_rules: all controls use local receipt ordering, direct token books, five-share depth, the same FAK fill model, fee rounding and resolved outcomes; only direction_reversal omits the candidate edge gate because edge direction is the tested placebo

statistics.stopping_clock: the earliest common decision receipt timestamp at which both 400 and 500 ms base arms independently have 1000 resolved full five-share fills across at least seven UTC days
statistics.partial_fills: included in variant risk, PnL and EV reporting but excluded from the primary stopping counts
